name: Bloodmage: Shadow Bat does not pull neutral mobs on its own (#10213)
contract: Call of the Darkwing 801958 is a stock SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 50069 (Shadow Bat), SummonProperties 61 (ally guardian). Native Guardian::InitStats unconditionally sets SetReactState(REACT_AGGRESSIVE) for every guardian summon, and bloodmage_darkwing_bat::OnPlayerAfterGuardianInitStatsForLevel (AscensionBloodmageDarkwing.cpp) only touched weapon damage, never the react state, so the bat kept REACT_AGGRESSIVE and independently engaged any hostile-faction unit within its own sight range via the native CreatureAI::MoveInLineOfSight, regardless of whether the Son of Arugal was fighting it - exactly the reported random pulls. The fix sets REACT_DEFENSIVE at the same init hook, matching the owner's own combat state (still assists when the owner fights something, via CreatureAI::OnOwnerCombatInteraction, which only REACT_PASSIVE would block) while no longer auto-engaging on sight. The fixture creature defaults to faction 14 (hostile to all) and reaction 0 (it will not attack first), standing within the bat's native sight/visibility range; the Son of Arugal never attacks it. Discriminating metric: owned_creature_victim for the Shadow Bat against the fixture, and the fixture's own combat state, both still zero after the bat has had several seconds to notice it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the bait has not engaged anyone yet
SETUP: the Son of Arugal is not in combat
Summon the Shadow Bat directly, bypassing Grim Omen's own proc chance
Let the Shadow Bat spawn and settle
SETUP: the Shadow Bat is present
Give native MoveInLineOfSight several passes to notice the nearby bait
DISCRIMINATING: the Shadow Bat never made the bait its victim
DISCRIMINATING: the bait never entered combat
The Son of Arugal was never pulled into combat either
